comment: The statement that ArchiMate is “broadly adopted” may overstate its practical accessibility in countries with limited enterprise-architecture capacity. Availability of the language and tools does not ensure the availability of trained modellers or sustainable modelling governance.

anchor.note: p.42 l.Lines 43-46 read as the printed page; section 3.1 agrees

public.text: The statement that ArchiMate is “broadly adopted” may overstate its practical accessibility in countries with limited enterprise-architecture capacity. Availability of the language and tools does not ensure the availability of trained modellers or sustainable modelling governance.
public.suggestedRevision: Acknowledge that ArchiMate expertise may be limited in some settings and provide a simplified adoption pathway, including reusable templates, training resources, minimum modelling conventions, and non-ArchiMate representations that map to the formal model.
